dimintheis-again.npc: Have you spoke to Avan, Caleb and Johnathon yet?

avan.player: Hello there Avan, I've had a bit of spare time lately, and I was wondering whether you had anything I could help you out with, like a quest or something?

avan.npc: Honestly [player name], everything is fantastic! What you did for me and my family is amazing. My lady was very impressed with the perfect jewellery you obtained for me!

avan.player: You know, I really have a LOT of spare time right now. Anything, I will help out with anything.

avan.npc: I couldn't bring myself to trouble you any further [player name]. Thank you for everything, but I am content.

avan.text: If Avan is not the last brother the player talks to:

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades slightly.

avan.text: If Avan is the last brother the player talks to:

steps.player: I do one quest for you all and it solves all of your problems? Amazing... I'll go and tell your father how happy you all are!

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come has almost faded completely.

avan-again.player: Are you absolutely sure there is nothing I can help you out with?

avan-again.npc: Look, I really just want to get on with my life, your insistence on wanting another quest is getting annoying!

caleb.player: Caleb! As an adventurer, I am ready to help you with whatever you need... again! What can I help you with?

caleb.text: You daydream briefly of what the rich family could offer you this time as a reward.

caleb.npc: ... and that's when I found the broken lamping stick. Maybe you could help me investigate?

caleb.player: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that, my mind was erm... elsewhere.

caleb.npc: Well if you aren't going to listen to the problem, it's fine, don't worry about it. Nothing an experienced chef can't solve himself!

caleb.player: I'm sorry! Please let me help.

caleb.npc: No! Not every problem in my life needs an adventurer to come solve it for me anyway. I'm happy and there's nothing else either!

caleb.text: If Caleb is not the last brother the player talks to:

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades even more.

caleb.text: If Caleb is the last brother the player talks to:

steps.player: I do one quest for you all and it solves all of your problems? Amazing... I'll go and tell your father how happy you all are!

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come has almost faded completely.

caleb-again.player: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, a chef can always do with help in their kitchen right?

caleb-again.npc: I'm a very competent cook! I do not need your assistance [player name]. Please leave me be.

johnathon.player: I killed demons, I cured your poison and restored your family's honour! What can I help you with next Johnathon?

johnathon.npc: Actually, come to think of it...
I've been having this issue. You see the lady I seek is trapped up the top of a very large tower of a very large castle, and has been for all of her life so far.
There is but one problem, a fierce dragon circles the castle, breathing fire at anyone who dares go near.

johnathon.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards sweeps over you with incredible speed.

johnathon.player: This is sounding like a great opportunity to be heroic, shall I go get her for you?

johnathon.npc: Ha ha! You would believe anything. That was just a children's story!

johnathon.player: Very funny Johnathon, I can't help but laugh...
So do you actually have any problems I can help you with?

johnathon.npc: Everything is fantastic [player name]! You adventurers really do seem to love quests, but I do not have one for you today.

johnathon.text: If Johnathon is not the last brother the player talks to:

steps.player: Very well, I'll go and see if your other brothers need anything...

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come fades even more.

johnathon.text: If Johnathon is the last brother the player talks to:

steps.player: I do one quest for you all and it solves all of your problems? Amazing... I'll go and tell your father how happy you all are!

steps.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards that may come has almost faded completely.

johnathon-again.player: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, perhaps even teach you about Death Rune magicks, where your skills do not live up to mine.

johnathon-again.npc: I find that very insulting [player name]. You do not need to remind me of your superior skills. Leave me be.

dimintheis-return.player: I have been and spoken to Avan, Caleb and Johnathon and none of them need anything from me!

dimintheis-return.npc: That is excellent news [player name]. It's good to hear they are doing well.

dimintheis-return.text: The sweet smell of the great rewards is a distant memory.

dimintheis-return.npc: Come to think of it, there is something you can help me out with!
Slow down. I haven't told you what it is yet!
I need 500,000 coins. Can you help me out with that?

dimintheis-return.player: You just want coins?! Aren't you wealthy! Why do you need coins from me?

dimintheis-return.npc: Okay, I suppose there will be no time better than this to tell you the truth.
Our family just pretends to be rich [player name]. We gave ourselves a fancy surname, pretended the gauntlets are a family heirloom and asked adventurers to solve our family issues.

dimintheis-return.player: Wait, so all of this was for nothing? You just lied to me!

dimintheis-return.npc: No no, your work was indeed very helpful, the crest is important to us, it helps to portray that we are indeed wealthy, despite the fact we are not.
I mean, if you were wealthy, would you live in a tiny house in the darkest corner of Varrock? Not a chance. This is your chance to do us a final favour, may I have 500,000 coins from you?

dimintheis-return.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.player: I don't have enough coins on me.

steps.text: You hand over 500,000 coins to Dimintheis.

steps.npc: Thank you very much. In appreciation, I will inform Avan, Caleb and Johnathon that you did yet another great deed for the family, and that you would find more pairs of those gauntlets useful.

steps.player: Well this didn't feel very heroic...
You don't need 500,000 coins from me! I don't believe you! You can keep your rewards.

steps.npc: I will be here if you change your mind.
